title: Inverse Reinforcement Learning with State-Dependent Foresight for Human Decision-Making
abstract: arXiv:2611.34351v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Computational modeling of behavior represents individuals with a model fitted to their observed behavior and characterizes them through its parameters. Naturalistic tasks incorporate the complexity of real environments and yield high-dimensional behavioral trajectories. Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) infers the latent reward function underlying these trajectories. Standard IRL, however, assumes effectively infinite-horizon planning, whereas human foresight is both bounded and state-dependent. Here we introduce SC-AIRL (State-Conditional Adversarial IRL), which builds these two cognitive properties into the planner. Per-depth policies share one reward but differ in how far ahead they sum it explicitly. A state-conditional router mixes them according to the current state. translated_title: 面向人类决策的具有状态依赖前瞻性的逆强化学习
translated_abstract: 行为的计算建模通过拟合个体观察到的行为来对其进行表示，并通过模型参数来刻画其特征。自然情境任务融合了真实环境的复杂性，并产生高维的行为轨迹。逆强化学习（IRL）可以推断这些轨迹背后的潜在奖励函数。然而，标准IRL假设规划在效果上是无限视界的，而人类的前瞻性既是有界的，又是依赖于状态的。在此，我们提出了SC-AIRL（状态条件对抗逆强化学习），它将这两种认知特性构建到规划器之中。不同前瞻深度的策略共享同一个奖励函数，但在显式累加奖励的前瞻范围上有所不同；一个状态条件路由器则根据当前状态对这些策略进行混合。在行人过街和高速公路超车任务的留出测试片段上，SC-AIRL相比标准AIRL提升了模仿性能，将top-1准确率从0.549提高至……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SC-AIRL（状态条件对抗逆强化学习），将人类前瞻性的有限性与状态依赖性这两种认知特性融入逆强化学习的规划器中，在行人过街和高速公路超车任务中显著提升了对人类行为的模仿效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SC-AIRL (State-Conditional Adversarial IRL), which builds the bounded and state-dependent nature of human foresight into the IRL planner, improving behavioral imitation over standard AIRL in pedestrian crossing and highway overtaking tasks.
